description: This source file implements network ping functionalities, including executing ping commands, parsing ping results, and providing APIs for pinging specific endpoints or named endpoints within a network plugin context.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: A class providing network-related functionalities, specifically ping operations, within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

methods.name: _doPing
methods.description: Performs a ping to a specified endpoint, parses the output, and returns the result as a JSON object.

methods.name: _doPingNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Performs a ping to a named endpoint, such as 'CMTS', by resolving it to an IP address and calling _doPing.
